name: Easy Agile Roadmaps
description: Easy Agile Roadmaps is a Jira-native roadmapping app for sequencing work across teams, organizing initiatives by hierarchy or theme, adding milestones, synchronizing dates with Jira and exporting stakeholder views.
agentUseSummary: Easy Agile Roadmaps cannot be connected directly to Relay agents because Easy Agile publishes no supported customer API, delegated OAuth contract, API-key contract or remote MCP service for Roadmaps. Jira's APIs can manage underlying Jira work items but do not grant authority over the new Roadmaps experience or its Easy Agile-hosted app data.

blocked.label: Connect Easy Agile Roadmaps
blocked.description: Easy Agile does not publish a supported customer OAuth, API-key, developer-console or remote MCP connection contract for Roadmaps.

blocked.label: Use Roadmaps app data
blocked.description: No supported public endpoints, schemas, permissions or rate limits are documented for reading or changing new-experience roadmap configuration and metadata stored in Easy Agile's cloud service.

blocked.label: Treat Jira access as Roadmaps access
blocked.description: Jira REST APIs can operate on Jira work items, boards and versions, but Jira authority alone is not a supported Easy Agile Roadmaps integration and does not cover Easy Agile-hosted app data.

blocked.label: Automate private Roadmaps interfaces
blocked.description: Relay will not automate the Jira-hosted app UI, reuse Atlassian Connect installation secrets or JWTs, scrape pages, reverse engineer private requests, or call undocumented app endpoints.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a supported customer-facing Easy Agile Roadmaps API or remote MCP service.

runtimeSupport.description: No documented public Easy Agile Roadmaps customer API or remote MCP service is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No documented public Easy Agile Roadmaps customer API or remote MCP service is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Easy Agile's current Roadmaps material documents an interactive Atlassian Marketplace app that reads and updates Jira through Jira REST APIs and stores some new-experience configuration in Easy Agile's cloud service, but it does not publish a supported customer-facing Roadmaps API, delegated OAuth contract, API-key contract, developer console or remote MCP service.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request Easy Agile or Atlassian credentials and do not show Connect. Reconsider Roadmaps only if Easy Agile publishes a supported distributable customer API or remote MCP service with documented authentication, endpoints and authority over Roadmaps app data.

evidence.supports: The current Atlassian Marketplace listing presents Easy Agile Roadmaps as a commercial Jira Cloud app installed into and synchronized with Jira.

Easy Agile documents that the app calls Jira REST APIs on behalf of the signed-in user using an Atlassian-managed Connect JWT and installation secret; this is app-internal authentication, not a customer integration contract.

The new Cloud Roadmaps experience stores configuration and metadata that cannot be stored in Jira on Easy Agile's cloud servers, so Jira API access does not represent the complete Roadmaps authority boundary.
The supported Roadmaps lifecycle is documented through the interactive Jira app: users create, configure, synchronize and delete roadmaps in its UI.
Easy Agile publishes a specifically named API page where an app has supported integration endpoints; the Roadmaps documentation contains no equivalent supported customer API contract.
